title: make ci and GitHub CI check different things; green locally does not mean green in CI
description:
The Makefile and .github/workflows/ci.yml diverge on every shared step:

- Makefile 'lint': 'cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings' — no --all-targets and no --workspace, so tests, benches, examples and non-default members' targets are not linted. CI uses 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings'.
- Makefile 'ci' (fmt-check lint test) never runs 'cargo build'. CI does.
- Makefile has no MSRV target, so the 1.75 constraint is unreachable locally.
- Makefile 'check' uses --workspace while 'lint' does not — inconsistent within the file itself.

A contributor who runs 'make ci' and sees it pass can still fail CI on clippy warnings in test code. That is the whole point of having a local ci target, and it does not hold.

Separately, both CI 'cargo test --all-targets' and Makefile 'cargo test --workspace' miss doctests: --all-targets explicitly excludes them (2 doc code fences exist in the tree). Run 'cargo test --workspace' and 'cargo test --workspace --doc', or drop --all-targets.

Make the Makefile targets the single definition and have CI invoke them, or delete the Makefile.
